name: Evolocumab
description: A fully human monoclonal antibody against PCSK9, approved to reduce cardiovascular events and to lower LDL cholesterol including in familial hypercholesterolaemia.

systems.note: LDL receptor recycling restored by PCSK9 blockade, lowering LDL cholesterol and event rate.

monitors.why: The direct index of the effect; reductions are large and fast.
Counts atherogenic particles at the low LDL-C values this drug produces, where the mass estimate degrades.
Particle concentration by NMR, read where the calculated LDL-C is too low to be reliable.
PCSK9 inhibition lowers Lp(a) modestly, unlike statins.
